title: Meridian expansions and classical symbols of quantum recurrences
status: Draft; every microscopic inverse-level order and a conditional selected geometric factor of an actual all-level recurrence
imports: Strict-source alternative: Moving-meridian source estimates for strict Conway tangles, Theorems 1.1–1.2, including its primitive local packet, all charges, source errors and exact normalization.

Circle-tree alternatives from Volume asymptotics for trees of crossing circles: Theorems 1.1–1.2 and Sections 2–6 for the summed source; or Theorem 1.3, Corollary 1.4, equations (7.3), (7.8), (7.9), and Sections 7.1–7.6 for the directed source. The all-orders proof extends the normalized directed induction without replacing its criterion by the summed condition.

Exact Newton calculus for tangles with a moving meridian, Proposition 6.1, Theorem 7.1 and Proposition 8.1; complete Hermite conditioning from Spectral estimates for Conway tangle sources, Lemma 2.1; canonical factorial interpolation from Holomorphic source asymptotics and volume limits for strict Conway compositions, Lemma 2.1 only.

The full modified dimension of Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, equation (10.11), fixes the exact reduced/full gauge. The proof assumes a specified fixed operator annihilating the whole state at every sufficiently large level; it does not construct one.

Only the geometric corollary imports Nonparabolic holonomy of trees of crossing circles, Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 7.1, and Preferred longitudes of Conway tree complements, Theorems 1.2–1.3. In the strict class it takes the maximum of the analytic and classical filling thresholds.

Translated compact estimates, finite-order remainders, directed normalized induction, polynomial filtration, gauge, injective regrading and the selected-factor implication are proved here. No fixed-M asymptotic, full A-polynomial equality or recurrence-existence claim is made.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
